title: Voxel Painter
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement an interactive 3D voxel painter that supports placing/deleting voxels, color selection, layer visibility control, and undo/redo. Refer to the official three.js example webgl_interactive_voxelpainter, but modify it substantially.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Grid and Foundation]
(1) A 16×16×16 voxel space. Each voxel is a 1×1×1 BoxGeometry unit.
(2) Place a 16×16 ground plane at the bottom (y=0) as the initial placement surface. Visually, the ground must be a light-gray, semi-transparent grid.
(3) Initial scene state: only the ground is present, voxelCount=0 (the ground is not included in voxelCount).

[Placing Voxels]
(4) Left-click without Shift: use the surface detected by the Raycaster (the ground or a face of an existing voxel) to place a new voxel in the direction of that surface's normal.
  - The Raycaster must correctly handle the face normal so that the new voxel is positioned outside the hit face.
  - The new voxel must use the currently selected color.
  - The placement position must be within the 16×16×16 range (x: 0-15, y: 0-15, z: 0-15); do not place a voxel if it is outside this range.
(5) Each voxel must be an independent Mesh (BoxGeometry + MeshLambertMaterial), with the color selected at the time of placement.

[Deleting Voxels]
(6) Shift+left-click an existing voxel: delete that voxel. The ground cannot be deleted.

[Color Palette]
(7) id="palette": a container containing 8 color buttons. The 8 colors (hexadecimal values) are:
  - #ff0000 (red), #00ff00 (green), #0000ff (blue), #ffff00 (yellow),
  - #ff8800 (orange), #8800ff (purple), #00ffff (cyan), #ffffff (white)
(8) Clicking a color button changes the currently selected color. The currently selected button must have a visual highlight, such as a thicker border.
(9) The first color (red, #ff0000) is selected by default.

[Layer Visibility]
(10) id="layerSlider": a range slider with min=0, max=16, step=1, and a default value of 16.
(11) The slider value represents the "visible layer upper limit": all voxels whose Y layer index is >= the layerSlider value must be hidden.
  - When layerSlider=16, all layers are visible (Y: 0-15 are all visible).
  - When layerSlider=8, only voxels with Y < 8 (layers 0-7) are visible.
  - When layerSlider=0, all voxels are hidden (but the ground remains visible at all times).

[Undo/Redo]
(12) id="undoBtn": the undo button. Undo the most recent placement or deletion operation.
(13) id="redoBtn": the redo button. Redo the most recently undone operation.
(14) The operation stack must retain at most 50 steps. Clear the redo stack after a new operation.

[Clear]
(15) id="clearBtn": clear all voxels, restoring the initial empty scene, and clear both the undo and redo stacks.

[HUD]
(16) id="voxelCount": the current total number of voxels, excluding the ground.

[Lighting and Camera]
- A white DirectionalLight shines from (10, 20, 10) with intensity 1.0.
- AmbientLight intensity is 0.5.
- Use OrbitControls, with the initial camera position aimed at the center of the grid.

[State Exposure (Required; Update Every Frame or After Each Operation)]
window.__3D_STATE__ = {
  voxelCount: number,           // Current total number of voxels, excluding the ground
  currentColor: string,         // Hexadecimal value of the currently selected color, such as "#ff0000"
  layerVisible: number,         // Current layer slider value (0-16)
  undoStackSize: number,        // Current size of the undo stack
  redoStackSize: number,        // Current size of the redo stack
  gridOccupancy: [number, ...]  // Array of length 16, where gridOccupancy[y] = number of voxels in Y layer y
}

Output a single standalone HTML file that can run when opened directly in a browser.
physics_constraints: 16x16x16 voxel grid, placement by face normal detection
Raycaster-based click placement on existing surface normals
gridOccupancy[y] must accurately reflect voxel count per layer
voxelCount must equal sum of gridOccupancy
